Operators and math functions for jax arrays

Source: R/methods.R
jax_operators.Rd

Arithmetic (+ - * / ^ %% %/%), comparison, logical (& | !) operators and %*% follow jax.numpy semantics (broadcasting, type promotion). Math group functions (exp, log, sqrt, abs, ...) and summaries (sum, max, ...) map to the jnp_ functions. These work on tracers too, so ordinary R code is transformable by grad(), vmap() and jit().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
Ops(e1, e2)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
matrixOps(x, y)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
chooseOpsMethod(x, y, mx, my, cl, reverse)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
Math(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
Summary(..., na.rm = FALSE)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
mean(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
t(x)

Arguments

e1, e2, x

Jax values or R data.

y

Second operand.

mx, my, cl, reverse

See base::chooseOpsMethod().

...

Further arguments.

na.rm

Ignored.
